title: Think Twice: Branch-and-Rethink Reasoning Reward Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the reward model's performance on RM-Bench, a benchmark specifically designed to probe whether the model unfairly favors longer responses over substantive quality.
Evaluating the reward model on RM-Bench, which tests the model's susceptibility to favoring candidates based on their presentation order (earlier or later in the prompt).
Measuring the model's performance on RewardBench and RM-Bench to assess its ability to resist superficial stylistic cues and evaluate actual correctness and reasoning.
